name: capture_o_video_usability_rubric
description: Versioned usability grading thresholds for capture-O companion video sources (#11270).

A.description: Full body + club visible address to finish, >= 60 fps, low blur at impact, static camera

B.description: Full body visible, club partly lost/blurred in the downswing, or 30 fps

C.description: Body partly cropped / heavy occlusion / moving camera, but the swing is identifiable

R.description: Not a swing, or unusable (reasons recorded); retained, not deleted
